'Updating client investment amount' most likely = growth adjustment (Adjust one investor / collective), which changes value not principal.

entries.title: Recording: correction/earlier are free-text reason codes; monthly investment = new reason option

Marking matured writes no ledger; withdrawal writes negative ledger + pending payout; reinvest moves growth to principal. Matured does not block contributions/SIPs; clients cannot see maturity status. SIP paid count: accepted sip_installment orders per plan (query exists sipPlanRepository.ts:94-103); not exposed per plan; client portfolio sipInstallmentCount is per fund and ignores reversals. Offline recorded contributions have no sip_plan_id. Safe 6b = scheduled pass creating pending maturity only (no payout), needs migration (marked_by_user_id NOT NULL -> nullable + actor_type, 039 pattern) and a configured term.

entries.title: Suspected bug: AutoPay SIP next_due_date may never advance; failed/refunded instalment stalls a plan
entries.text: STATIC, LIKELY not proven (explorer; verify in T7). mandateCollectionWorker.ts:89-101 prepareCollection advances next_due_date only when the existing order is accepted AND now is between notifyAt and debitAt; debit happens at debitAt (10:00 IST, :60-66), so acceptance cannot occur inside that window and the early return at :90 skips later passes. No other code advances AutoPay next_due_date; no test. Also: manual SIP worker treats any non-accepted state as waiting (sipScheduleWorker.ts:99-104) so refund_*/cancelled instalments block forever; AutoPay failed debit blocks the month (mandate_collection_attempts unique per plan+period, 035:233) with no retry/skip. Manual vs AutoPay completion use different rules (elapsed months vs accepted count). Matured positions still accept SIP contributions.

entries.title: BUG (verified STATIC): AutoPay SIP next_due_date never advances after a scheduled debit
entries.text: Verified in T7 by reading backend_controller/src/mandateCollectionWorker.ts. runMandateCollectionPass lists plans via listAutoPayDue (next_due_date <= now+24h IST; sipPlanRepository.ts:89-92). prepareCollection returns null when now >= debitAt (:90), BEFORE the only code that advances next_due_date (:95-101, which also requires the period's order to be accepted). The collection is debited at debitAt (10:00 IST) and resolved afterwards by reconcileCollections, so the order becomes accepted only after the window closes; every later pass exits at :90. advanceNextDueDate has no other AutoPay caller (only sipScheduleWorker for manual_checkout, and mandatesRepository.ts:379 at activation). mandateCollectionWorker.test.ts has no multi-month advance case; integration tests do not cover it. Effect: AutoPay plans collect the setup instalment plus the first scheduled month, then stop scheduling; plan stays active, re-listed each pass. No wrong money moves (missed collections only). Fix direction: advance when the period's order is accepted regardless of window (or on collection success), with a failing test first. Not RUNTIME-verified; whether AutoPay commands are enabled in production (commandEnabled) is unknown.

entries.title: DD 2/3/4: web app already live on app.beonedge.in; gaps are AutoPay-on-web, signup landing page, mail links

Add CLIENT_WEB_APP_URL -> EmailTemplateConfig.webAppUrl rendered at send time (queued payloads unaffected). App-update mail goes to every active user incl. web/iOS.

entries.title: BUG (verified): individual client growth can double-append; new idempotency key per attempt
entries.text: Verified STATIC in T7. frontend_stack_ts/src/features/admin/shared/adminQueries.ts:586-602 useIndividualClientGrowth mints a fresh key inside mutationFn (mintIdempotencyKey() at :598), unlike createClient (:560-564) and recordedContribution (:644-649) which take a caller-held key. AdminIndividualClientGrowthBody (packages/contracts/src/operations/admin-money.ts:46-55) has no expected-version/latestEntryId guard, so a retry after a timeout or a second click on the still-filled form (IndividualClientGrowthScreen ~:359) appends a second growth_adjustment. Violates RULES rule 6 (never mint a new key to recover an unknown result). Timeout path also tells the admin 'Nothing has changed' (~:139), possibly false. Collective growth commit (:718) mints per call too (preview/commit flow; check). Success invalidation only covers ['admin','users'] (:602, :722) so investor positions stay stale. Directly affects DD point 8 (returns after updates).

entries.title: Admin API: app-config publish has no version guard; mandate reconcile not atomic (both verified)
entries.text: Verified STATIC in T7. (1) adminContentRoutes.ts:438-480 publish computes max(version)+1 with no expectedVersion/If-Match and an optional idempotency key; concurrent publishes collide on app_config_versions_version_uk (016:132, likely 500) and a stale screen can silently undo minimumSupportedVersion raised by a required app-update announcement (appUpdateAnnouncement.ts:128). (2) adminMandateRoutes.ts:371 calls reconcileMandateFact inside runAdminMutation's tx, but reconcileMandateFacts.ts:94 opens its own unitOfWork transaction, so the mandate state change commits apart from the audit row and idempotency receipt. Mandate routes only mount when the PhonePe verifier and relay recurring gateway are configured (composition.ts:719-753), so with payments disabled (rule-2) this is dormant but must be fixed before re-enable.

entries.title: Admin API: route/contract paths match; validation drift, optional keys, UTC dates, open Q-013/Q-017
entries.text: STATIC (explorer). All 17 admin route modules mounted; 87 admin routes each have a matching contract op; no automated parity check (backend never imports contracts). Drift: client-growth signedPaise regex allows zero/leading zeros/over-bigint (adminClientGrowthRoutes.ts:92-95) vs bounded contract; create-fund openingAum lacks bigint max (adminCatalogRoutes.ts:73-76); AUM bps 0 allowed by contract, refused by backend; email template route limits looser than contract (domain enforces); contract marks x-csrf-token required though admin_native bearer skips CSRF; listAdminInvestorPositions documents RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND but returns empty. Validation: growth effectiveDate regex-only (2026-13-45 reaches Postgres), no future guard on growth/AUM dates; not-future checks use UTC so IST 00:00-05:30 cannot record today. Optional idempotency on fund create/version/lifecycle/stocks, FAQ, app-config, suspend/reinstate/close (retried create-fund duplicates fund + opening AUM). Growth commit uses its own idempotency protocol without rejectExpiredKey. users.read_limited returns full email/phone. Open: Q-013 sole admin can suspend/close itself; Q-017 set/reset links share 10-min lifetime; 7 permission codes unenforced; maker-checker unwired; seed re-grants revoked rows; changing ADMIN_LOGIN_ID makes a second superadmin. Append-only is by comment only (no triggers/grants). No delete/anonymize code; pii_tombstoned_at never set; 63 FKs to users mostly RESTRICT; audit_events/auth_login_events have no FK and would retain PII.

entries.title: Compat (verified): client and admin APKs reject unknown response keys and enum values; only new endpoints are safe
entries.text: Verified STATIC. Client contracts use z.strictObject throughout (client.ts 15, client-account.ts 16; also client-orders, client-sips, client-profile, envelope.ts:66,126); frontend_stack_ts/src/api/http.ts:296-302 safeParse failure throws TransportError('malformed') for the whole call; released v0.14.7 identical. So any new key on an existing client or admin response, or a new value in OrderType (client-orders.ts:10), LedgerEntryType (client.ts:117), ClientInvestmentStatus, SipState, PaymentAttemptState, or admin enums such as AdminMaturity.settlement (admin-maturity.ts:65), breaks released APKs (admin APK too, app.ts:11). Tolerant: NotificationItem.kind is z.string() and payload z.record(unknown) (client-account.ts:32,37); old APKs show unknown kinds as plain title/body; deepLink only opens if the route exists in that build (builds <= v0.15.2 lack 7332bf6 and show a failing Open for unknown routes; '/activity' exists everywhere). Error codes are not checked per operation, so adding DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE to any op is safe. Rule for the plan: new data reaches clients only through new endpoints and notification payload keys.

entries.title: BUG with payments off (verified): SIP worker and client order/SIP creation keep producing unpayable orders
entries.text: Verified STATIC. sipScheduleWorker (built without a gateway, workerComposition.ts:294-317; prod every 300s) creates a sip_installment order per due period for active manual_checkout plans and notifies 'Your monthly SIP installment is due. Open the app to pay it.' (createSipInstallmentOrder.ts:77-84); plan then waits on the open order forever (sipScheduleWorker.ts:99-104), no order expiry found. Client createSip (clientSipPlanRoutes.ts:62-112) and createClientOrder (clientOrderRoutes.ts:93-135) have no gateway check; only POST pay refuses with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (clientOrderRoutes.ts:154-156), shown as 'Payments are temporarily unavailable. Your investment is saved' (frontend domain/failure.ts:132-137). AutoPay create saves the plan first then fails (clientAutoPaySipRoutes.ts:289). Published app-config featureFlags exist but no client reads them; canInvest=false misleadingly redirects to verify-email. Safe fix: refuse order/SIP creation server-side with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE when the gateway is absent (existing copy failure.ts:124-126,151) and have the SIP worker skip creation; additive, released APKs already handle the code.

entries.title: Design facts: receipts, growth notices, maturity schedule, admin prompt, admin-tracked SIP
entries.text: STATIC (explorer). Receipts: no client receipt concept; recorded contribution shows as notification client_contribution_recorded (fixed text, payload {fundId}), Activity 'Earlier investment', a provider-less succeeded payment, and a one-off investment; reason_code stored on client_value_entries but never returned to clients. Proposal: category store (table or nullable col, mapped from reason_code), new GET /v1/client/receipts(/{id}) + screen, per-category notification text, payload {entryId, orderId, fundId, category, deepLink:'/activity'}. Growth: individual and collective already write a client_value_updated notification per client (adminClientGrowthRoutes.ts:350-356, 500-506; fixed text, no amounts, payload {fundId}); zero-delta targets get nothing (clientGrowth.ts:164); records = client_growth_batches + one growth_adjustment entry per client; client sees it only as 'Growth' rows. Need: payload entryId/deepLink, new GET /v1/client/value-updates + screen, optional email. Maturity: matured_on cannot be future (maturitySettlement.ts:55-60); no planned maturity date anywhere; new client_maturity_schedules table (user, fund, optional order, maturity_date, state, resolution CHECK, maturity_id FK, follow-up schedule id, actor/version) keyed by user+fund; existing reinvestment only moves growth to principal and refuses with no growth (:181-199); keep settlement enum untouched, record resolution in new table via new endpoints. No admin notification mechanism; prompt fits AdminFrame signed-in branch (AdminFrame.tsx:52,123, Modal already used) calling new GET /v1/admin/maturities/due, in-memory dismissal so it returns each launch. Admin-tracked SIP: prefer separate admin_sip_schedules + link table (reusing sip_plans exposes pause/cancel to clients and old APKs); recordings can be sip_installment orders (investment_orders_sip_link CHECK, unique plan+due_period) or linked entries; months-paid via new endpoint.

entries.title: Onboarding BUGS (verified): typo email unfixable, contacts never freed, invite link dies before mail retries
entries.text: Verified STATIC. (1) Create client queues the set-password link immediately with no confirm step (CreateClientScreen.tsx:72-89,216); no admin route edits email/phone (adminOversightRoutes.ts:5-10); users_email_uk/users_phone_uk are UNIQUE across every user state (010_canonical_identity.sql:33-34), and migration 056 'released contacts' only narrowed APPLICATION indexes, so a closed account keeps its email and phone forever: a typo account lets the typo inbox owner take the account, and recreating the client with the same phone hits STATE_CONFLICT permanently. (2) Set link lifetime = shared email-code TTL (600000 ms in examples; composition.ts:460, environment.ts:155) while mail retries wait 1/5/15 min (retrySchedule.ts RETRY_DELAYS_MS) and passwordLinkMailGuard.ts:29 cancels expired links, so an SMTP outage over ~6-7 min silently cancels the invite; email says '10 minutes' from issue not send; same key drives verification codes (Q-017). (3) Setting the password via the link does not mark the email verified (passwordCredential.ts ~213-253) though the link proves the inbox at the current email revision, so new clients must still enter an emailed code before investing.

entries.title: Client journey: recordings say 'before you joined', no Open links, one-off count, no risk footnote, dead tickets
entries.text: STATIC; deepLink and BOE- verified. (1) Every admin recording notifies 'earlier investment... before you joined' (recordContribution.ts:41-47) and Activity labels it 'Earlier investment'. (2) Notifications open only payload.deepLink/link/path (NotificationsScreen.tsx:30-41); recordings, value updates, reversal, maturity, payout, SIP due carry {fundId}/{payoutId} so no Open button; only fund-receipt sets deepLink. (3) Portfolio counts recorded monthly payments as 'one-off investments' (clientPortfolioRoutes.ts:192-193; PortfolioScreen.tsx:120-122); contributionCount already in response. (4) 'Investments are subject to market risk.' only on SplashScreen; Portfolio has no as-of date though lastUpdated returned. (5) Support tickets reach nobody (no admin route) yet client is told 'We reply by email'; status stays Open forever. (6) Ticket reference prefix 'BOE-' (clientAccountRoutes.ts:462) breaks copy rule. (7) SIP screens promise instalments in Activity and a frozen 'Next on {past date}'; recorded payments not linked to plans. (8) Old pending payments never settle with gateway off; PaymentStatusScreen polls every 4s forever and shows a past 'Pay by'; no client cancel. (9) Recorded payment detail shows invented 5:30 pm time (midday UTC). (10) Failed eligibility read shown as 'Locked' on Dashboard/Profile. Statements: no download/print/share. Missing: how-to-pay/bank details (FAQ, maintainer-authored), support contact. app-config config is z.record(unknown) so featureFlags.onlinePayments can hide pay CTAs with no contract change.

entries.title: Admin workflow: ~10 clicks per payment, ledger capped at 25, raw ids in preview, no support inbox, no hub
entries.text: STATIC; ledger cap, support, invited filter verified. Recording one monthly payment = ~10 interactions/3 page loads; no bulk or CSV. Bugs: ledger query sends no limit so default 25 applies (adminRouteKit.ts:20) hiding older entries (and their reversal); collective preview shows raw userIds (CollectiveClientGrowthScreen.tsx:231); paise inputs (IndividualClientGrowthScreen.tsx:294-311, MaturityPanel.tsx:89); investor record not linkable (state only, ClientPositionDetailScreen.tsx:55); pickers list admin/closed accounts; 'Invited' filter dead because admin-created users start active (createClientAccount.ts:87); mobile bottom bar promotes Applications/Receipts not Users (adminRoutes.ts:42,230,63); collective commit no confirm; reason codes quarterly vs quarterly_valuation. Missing: monthly payment sheet (rows per client/fund, per-row idempotency key, UTR bank reference; new read endpoint), monthly value-update sheet using existing per-client items API (new read endpoint fund client positions), support inbox (support.read/write seeded unused; client already renders status/resolutionNote), daily overview counts, single client hub page (mostly FE; deliveries already filter by userId), deliveries link to client + 'send new link', audit presets/client links, accounting CSV exports and structured bank reference for reconciliation. All via new endpoints or FE.

entries.title: CORRECTION (TESTED by lane a-payments-off): SIP worker never created orders; its pass throws on a non-uuid requestId
entries.text: Replaces finding-15's worker claim. TESTED on real PostgreSQL by lane a-payments-off: sipScheduleWorker.ts:162 builds requestId 'sip-schedule-<id>-<ms>', but audit_events.request_id is uuid, so every instalment creation rolls back and the pass throws (worker heartbeat fails). mandateCollectionWorker.ts:111 has the same shape. So the worker never created unpayable orders; only client createSip's own first instalment and lump-sum createClientOrder did. Also STATIC: createSip creates the instalment for YYYY-MM-01 while next_due_date=today, so a fixed worker would add a second same-month order. Lane a-payments-off makes the worker skip without a gateway (warns PAYMENT_GATEWAY_NOT_CONFIGURED) and refuses client creation; the uuid and double-month fixes belong to E2 before any payments re-enable. Client-side creation refusal and copy remain valid from finding-15.

entries.title: Local integration run with coverage fails the 80% branch gate on clean main (78.25%); CI disables coverage there
entries.text: TESTED by lanes a-admin-core and a-payments-off in the Node 22 container: `npm run test:integration` passes every test (35 files/390 on clean base 81b29aa) but exits 1 because global branch coverage is 78.25% < 80%. CI runs `npm run test:integration -- --coverage.enabled=false` (.github/workflows/ci.yml backend job), so CI is green. Not caused by any lane. Lanes and phase closes run integration with `-- --coverage.enabled=false` like CI. Whether to lower the local threshold or add coverage is a maintainer decision for later; not blocking.

entries.title: Stale expiry scope: only never-sent checkouts expire; sent ones still read 'Awaiting payment' in Activity
entries.text: Lane a-expire-stale (d8a76a4, TESTED in the container: integration 37 files/400 tests with coverage off; negative controls fail as expected) expires one-time checkout attempts in state created whose dispatch never started, whose payment is created with no other live or settled attempt, once expiresAt plus PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_EXPIRY_GRACE_SECONDS (default 300 s) has passed, and only while no gateway is configured. Left alone by coordinator decision under rule-10 ('never touch a payment the provider might still settle'): provider_pending attempts and created attempts whose dispatch started. PhonePe callbacks 404 while there is no gateway, so some of these may be paid but unrecorded; reconciliation decides once a gateway returns. Client view for those rows: PaymentStatusScreen shows the lapsed message 5 min after pay-by. The Activity Payments list (ActivityScreen.tsx:58 filter, :208 label) still says 'Awaiting payment' because list items carry no expiresAt. Route to B-L6-client-investing (simplified History when payments are off) or a new list endpoint; never add a key to the existing list response (finding-14).

entries.title: Fund receipt queue likely repeats a row at page boundaries (ms cursor vs µs timestamps)
entries.text: STATIC, reported by lane b-support (note-39), not yet verified: the admin fund receipt queue pages oldest first with a keyset cursor that encodes a millisecond timestamp, while Postgres stores microseconds. A row whose created_at has sub-millisecond digits can compare as after the cursor and be shown again on the next page. The b-support lists avoid this by sorting and comparing on the timestamp truncated to milliseconds. To fix: confirm with an integration test (two rows a few microseconds apart at the page boundary), then apply the same truncation or encode microseconds in the cursor. Check the other keyset lists (http/cursor.ts users) for the same pattern.

entries.title: usePagedQuery loadAll re-fires fetchNextPage after a failed page (loop risk in useFundCatalogue)
entries.text: STATIC, reported by lane b-client-investing (not fixed): the shared paged query helper's loadAll option keeps calling fetchNextPage after a page fails, so a persistent error can re-request in a loop. It currently affects useFundCatalogue. b-client-investing's OnlinePaymentHistory uses its own guarded effect that stops on a failed page. Fix: stop the walk on the first failed page and surface the error with retry. Belongs to a later frontend hardening task.

entries.title: Release note: an old email worker permanently fails investment_recorded mail; deploy workers with the API
entries.text:
TESTED by reading, not run: dispatchDueDeliveries settles a delivery whose template has no guard or renderer as 'unsendable' with disposition 'permanent'. A v0.15.x email worker therefore dead-letters any investment_recorded delivery queued by a Phase B API.
Normal deploy: _boe_deploy.sh runs migrate and then `compose up -d --remove-orphans`, which recreates the API and the workers together, so the window is seconds.
Rollback to v0.15.x after Phase B has queued investment emails: any not yet sent are permanently failed, not retried.
Put both points in the Phase B release notes. The maintainer can resend from the admin email tools if needed. No code change (lane b-receipts security review, SHOULD-FIX 1).

entries.title: FX-1 (rule 4): client router rebuilt every render; Home and Profile hang on a failed eligibility read
entries.text:
RUNTIME (U1, U2) and STATIC, re-read on 02985f9. UCM-01, UCW-01.
Symptom: with client reads failing, Home keeps 10 skeletons and "Checking..." for good and re-requests each of its seven reads about 78 times a minute; Profile keeps "Checking..." and a blank nominee panel. Other screens show the failure panel in 8 to 15 s. Evidence: .temp/closed/u-audits/shots/states/client/390x844/dashboard.fail.60s.png, results/states-client.json.
Cause: frontend_stack_ts/src/shells/client/ClientRoutes.tsx:12-30 calls buildRouter in render (only the gate object is memoised), and app/routing/buildRouter.tsx:31-35,81-88 creates a new lazy() component per route on every call, so each eligibility state change remounts the open screen and restarts its reads. A half-filled form would also reset on an eligibility refetch. The admin shell memoises its router once (shells/admin/AdminShellRoot.tsx:56-65).
Rule 4: a failed read must never become an endless skeleton.
Fix direction: stable router and lazy components; let the eligibility failure reach the existing failure patterns; run the boot guards and the acyclic chunk check (rule 8).
Payment screens: none touched. Plan: docs/ui-overhaul/plan.md, lane fx-shell.

entries.title: FX-6 (rule 4): a failed "Show more" or background refetch is silent in both apps
entries.text:
STATIC (U6, U7), re-read on 02985f9. CC-13, CA-12; carried CL-11 (H4); related finding-25.
frontend_stack_ts/src/ui/patterns/LoadMore.tsx:11-21 renders only "N so far" and "Show more"; PagedListState (api/paged.ts:12-17) carries no error, and AsyncBoundary (ui/patterns/AsyncBoundary.tsx:52) shows an error only when there is no data. So when the next page or a refetch fails, the loaded rows stay and nothing says the list is incomplete. 34 LoadMore lists: 9 client (notifications, reviews, value updates, activity, support, receipts, invested-fund lists) and 25 admin (users, ledger, audit, maturities, emails and others). finding-25: the paged hook can re-fire fetchNextPage after a failed page under loadAll.

entries.title: Auth refresh resends a write as whichever admin now owns the cookies (rule 6); CSRF refusal reads as Nothing changed
entries.text: From review-23 (static trace, 2026-11-17). (1) MEDIUM, pre-existing (ca4730a, 5bec7a6): frontend_stack_ts/src/api/http.ts:326-348 sendWithAuthRecovery resends any method once, same Idempotency-Key, after a 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED and a 'rotated' refresh; shells/admin/adminRuntime.ts:169-186 executeCookieRefresh stores principalFrom(data.user) without comparing it to the tab's admin. If admin B signed in in another tab and B's access cookie has expired, a Check again or submit in tab 1 rotates B's session and the write applies again under admin:B (idempotency is per admin, adminRouteKit.ts:115-127) and is audited as B; tab 1 then sends as B. Today unique indexes and expectedVersion limit it to wrong attribution; ledger writes without natural uniqueness would apply twice. Fix: when the refreshed user differs from the cached principal, end the session instead of 'rotated'; same class for the client runtime. Must land before fx-admin-values adopts persisted holds. (2) LOW: a Check again refused before processing (403 CSRF_INVALID) is classed as definite (api/errors.ts:79), so useHeldWrite drops the hold and shows Nothing changed although the first attempt may have applied (rule 4). (3) LOW: no test for cookie restore, F3, or no-principal persistence.

entries.title: Session guard residue: client restore race and outage-held principal (fx-session-guard)
entries.text: From review-28 and review-29 of lane fx-session-guard (finding-50 closed). Residue, accepted, LOW: (1) Client web: if investor B finishes signing in in another tab while this tab's getClientWebCsrf response (as A) is still in flight, this tab stores A over B's stored principal, the other tab ends instead, and this tab reads B's data under A's name until the next 401 or refresh (at most the 10-minute access-token lifetime, webAuth.ts:60). Admin web is covered by the getAdminSession compare in cookieRestore. A full fix needs a server-checked expected user on reads (an API change, rule 11). (2) After a restore that fails with an outage, the signed-out screen may still hold the principal hydrated from localStorage, so the transport guard treats the tab as holding a user; no signed-out screen sends a signed-in read today. Kept so an outage at reload does not drop persisted held writes (rule 6). (3) N4: the first detection calls getWebCsrf with the other user's cookies and rotates their CSRF token once per tab. (4) Native signed-out screens can hold a cached user, so an outage never deletes the refresh token.

entries.text: From the fx-session-guard runtime pass (evidence 8716f1e9, 2026-11-17). entries.title: Fund terms publish has no expected-version guard on the server (API change needed)
entries.text: From review-31 of lane fx-admin-funds (M2). The admin 'Publish new terms' request carries no base version and the backend publish route has no expected-version check, so an admin whose page shows version 3 can publish version 5 from version 3's terms after another admin published version 4, silently undoing their changes. fx-admin-funds adds a screen-side re-read before sending, which narrows the window but cannot close it. The real fix is an expected version on the publish operation (contract, backend route, frontend): an API change under rule 11, for a later backend lane with a contract change and an expand-first rollout.

entries.title: Session guard residue after 8d6fffd: cross-renderer storage lag and outage-held principal (fx-session-guard)
entries.text: From review-28 to review-32 and the runtime pass (evidence 8716f1e9) of lane fx-session-guard; finding-50 closed. Correction: the earlier text said admin web was covered by the getAdminSession compare; it was not (a sign-in by another admin finishing while the session read was in flight left the tab showing A with B's cookies). 8d6fffd closes that and the client twin: a web restore ends as revoked, writing nothing, when another tab stored a different user while it waited on the server. Residue, accepted, LOW: (1) localStorage changes reach other renderers asynchronously, so another tab's write landing between a restore's check and its own write can still interleave; the subscribe-time check and the listener end the wrong tab in most orderings. A full fix needs a server-checked expected user on reads (an API change, rule 11). (2) After a restore that fails with an outage, the signed-out screen may still hold the principal hydrated from localStorage; no signed-out screen sends a signed-in read; kept so an outage at reload does not drop persisted held writes (rule 6). (3) N4: the first detection calls getWebCsrf with the other user's cookies and rotates their CSRF token once per tab. (4) Native signed-out screens can hold a cached user, so an outage never deletes the refresh token. Hold keys are beo.admin.*.

entries.title: Client growth route re-runs a resent key after its idempotency receipt expires (backend)
entries.text: From review-33 of lane fx-admin-values. Admin writes through runAdminMutation (adminRouteKit.ts:158: ledger reversal, mark matured, settle, payout) refuse a key whose receipt has expired as reused. The client growth routes (adminClientGrowthRoutes.ts:234-255, individual and collective) have no expired-key check, so a resend after the receipt lifetime (IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS, default 24 h) runs the adjustment again. The frontend hold expiry (fx-admin-values) stops offering Check again after 24 h, which covers the default, but if the deployed IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS is shorter, a Check again inside the frontend window would apply a second adjustment. Recorded contributions use durable receipts (retention durable, adminClientPositionRoutes.ts:99) and are not affected. Fix: give the growth routes the same expired-key refusal (or durable retention); a backend lane, no contract change. Also verify the deployed IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS.

entries.title: Client growth route on a resent key after its receipt's lifetime: no second apply, but answer unverified (backend)
entries.text: Corrected by review-35 of lane fx-admin-values (the earlier text, from review-33, said a resend after expiry runs the adjustment again). runGrowthCommit (adminClientGrowthRoutes.ts:247-256) runs the write and inserts the idempotency receipt in one transaction; the insert has no conflict handling (idempotencyRepository.ts:61-81) and idempotency_records_scope_uk is unique on the key (012_canonical_rbac_platform.sql:158). Nothing in backend_controller/src deletes expired receipts (only erasure deletes, clientErasureDeleteRepository.ts:72), so a resend after IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS fails the insert and rolls the whole write back: no second apply. Open: which status the client then gets (likely a 500 from the unique violation, which the frontend treats as unknown), whether anything outside the repository prunes receipts, and the deployed IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS. A backend lane could answer such a resend as IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED like runAdminMutation (adminRouteKit.ts:158). The frontend's 24 h cut-off for ordinary holds stays right.
